headline: Budget transfers, including $14,744,773 in added special education funding and $500,000 for the Chippanee golf course.
summary: The agenda lists budget transfers and added funding for several city departments and grant funds. It also includes a Fire Department bid waiver to Firematic and a Comptroller authorization to countersign contracts.
items: Aging: additional $17,478 within the Senior Center Activity Fund
ECD: transfer of $50,000 within the CDBG Fund
PRYCS: additional $10,000 and transfers totaling $6,906 within the Special Grants and Donations Fund
BECC: transfers totaling $9,000 within the Special Grants and Donations Fund
BOE: additional $8,856 within the Special Grants and Donations Fund
BOE: additional $14,744,773 within the Special Education Grant Fund
Public Works: transfers totaling $43,500 within the Equipment Building Sinking Fund
Public Works: additional $37,000 within the Transfer Station Fund
Police Department: transfer of $50,000 from the General Fund Contingency account
Fire Department: transfer of $50,000 from the General Fund Contingency account
Fire Department: bid waiver to Firematic
PRYCS: additional $500,000 within the Chippanee Municipal Golf Course Fund
Comptroller's Office: authorization of the Comptroller, or Assistant Comptroller, to countersign contracts as to availability of funding
location: City Hall Council Chambers, 111 North Main Street, Bristol, Connecticut
